introduction: I'm a final-year Information Technology student with a strong passion for Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, and modern application development. I enjoy designing scalable software solutions, building clean architectures, and transforming ideas into real-world products.

My primary focus is ASP.NET Core, Flutter, SQL Server, Firebase, and AI integration using Large Language Models. Through academic projects, internships, and team leadership experience, I've developed practical skills in software architecture, backend development, mobile applications, and AI-powered systems.
about.career_objective: My goal is to become an AI Software Engineer who builds intelligent, scalable, and user-centered applications. I aim to contribute to innovative software products while continuously improving my expertise in software architecture, cloud technologies, and artificial intelligence.
